name: LemurSaucePacket
description: A Create-powered SMP that still feels like Minecraft. Build factories, rail networks and airships, explore a reworked world, and fight your way up the ages.

news.title: 1.1: Gear, capes and the guide
news.body: The Armory is open: a tree-felling Lumber Axe, an Excavator's 3x3 pickaxe, a Prospector's pickaxe that smelts what it mines, a Harvester's Scythe, a Builder's Wand, three weapons and five armour sets with full-set bonuses (Prospector, Aeronaut, Brass Duelist, Compacted Diamond, Compacted Netherite). All Create-made and skill-gated; the rarest pieces only drop in dungeons. Relics is in, with set synergies. Capes: earn them from skills at 99, finished chapters and real feats; ESC → Capes. And every page of the new wiki is in your inventory as the LemurSaucePacket Guide (ESC → Guide).

news.title: Welcome to LemurSaucePacket
news.body: Press Play. The launcher installs Minecraft, NeoForge and every mod for you, keeps them in sync with the server, and drops you straight in.
